name: class-sz
description: Specialized Claude assistance for class_sz (independent Boltzmann + halo-model theory code extending CLASS) and classy_szfast (Python wrapper, CosmoPower emulators, JAX differentiable pipeline). Covers full cosmology runs (matter Pk, CMB Cls, lensing) plus halo-model observables (tSZ, kSZ, CIB, galaxy auto/cross, cluster counts), and recipes for wiring class_sz into cobaya likelihoods (including the tSZ Cl^yy power-spectrum bandpower fit from the may26 workdir).
